title: All Together Now
coreMove: Combine humility, savings, patience, and enough into one repeatable temperament.
sourcePressure: The strongest advice works as a system: margin protects patience, savings protect freedom, enough protects judgment.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning the recap into a generic list of tips.
